decisive_items: Krebs von den Lungen-6 level: 1250 U/mL (normal <500 U/mL)
response.rationale: Recurrent diffuse GGO and lymphocytic BAL after TC chemotherapy, with elevated KL-6 and negative infection/CTD workup, best fit chemotherapy-induced pulmonary toxicity; HP is less likely without exposure and with negative anti-T. asahii.

rejected.why: Same diagnosis but lacks supported TC chemotherapy etiology specificity.
No evidence of lymphoma; BAL cytology negative.
IPF would show fibrosis/honeycombing, not lymphocytic BAL and centrilobular nodules.
HP shares CT/BAL findings but no exposure and anti-T. asahii negative.
Infectious pneumonia unsupported by negative cultures/Grocott and normal β-D-glucan.
PJP unlikely with normal β-D-glucan and negative Grocott/culture.
Pulmonary fibrosis lacks usual fibrotic CT pattern and BAL lymphocytosis.
Broader drug-induced lung injury; TC chemotherapy is the specific supported trigger.
CTD autoantibodies negative and no connective tissue disease features.
Lymphangitic carcinomatosis unsupported by negative cytology and GGO-predominant pattern.
No radiation exposure history; timing tied to chemotherapy.
